subject: NovumAI — request for bridgeback pilot extension + one-off credits
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: NovumAI ask — extra sandbox time + credits (needs exec signoff)

Hiro / Marissa —

Quick summary: NovumAI (enterprise buyer in healthcare analytics) hit our PLG sandbox ceiling earlier than expected after increasing sequence throughput during model tuning. They need an additional evaluation runway to finish a compliance benchmark and complete procurement. Asks: 60-day sandbox extension (we normally cap at 30) and a one-time credit of 150,000 generate tokens (~$9k list value) to cover the heavier runs.

Why this matters: NovumAI showed 3x token usage in last 7 days for inference tests that are representative of a production deployment. They're queued for a procurement decision by mid-September; legal/procurement are engaged. Win appears likely but require the extra runway to validate latency/throughput on our dedicated config.

Risk / asks: This is beyond standard PLG policy — needs exec approval. If approved, recommend tying extension + credits to: (1) a signed addendum confirming procurement timeline (DocuSign link included once agreed), and (2) a technical checkpoint at day 30 to validate progress.

Attached: NovumAI_POC-Telemetry-Summary.pdf (token burn + latency plots) and procurement note they shared.

Next step: Can we get signoff today? Customer is hoping to finalize procurement timelines by Fri.

— Ben
From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: NovumAI ask — extra sandbox time + credits (needs exec signoff)

Thanks Ben. Reviewed the telemetry attachment — the usage spike looks genuine and tied to a single test harness. 2 quick questions before we escalate to CRO:

1) Is the ask purely for inference tokens (no fine-tuning) and are there any data residency concerns?
2) Procurement asked for written terms for the addendum. Do we have a one-pager that ties the extension to a purchase/order by a fixed date?

My thinking: I'm open to a conditional one-time exception: 60-day sandbox + 150k tokens, but only if procurement signs an addendum that converts to a paid reserved seat/order by 2026-09-20 OR agrees to a committed minimum spend. Otherwise we set it to 30 days + 75k tokens.

Marissa — can you draft the addendum language and an internal note for finance (impact on revenue recognition and credit write-off)? Aditya — FYI / would like your take on the credit bucket impact.

— Hiro
From: Elena Ramos <elena@novumai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyanka Singh <psingh@novumai.com>, procurement@novumai.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: NovumAI ask — extra sandbox time + credits (needs exec signoff)

Hi Ben / Hiro —

Thank you for the fast response. Quick clarifications from our side:
- This is inference only; no model uploads or fine-tuning.
- Data residency: everything runs in our VPC/dedicated test network and logs are scrubbed per our compliance needs. No cross-tenant data.
- Procurement: we can sign a short addendum that commits to a purchase order intent and a target go-live date (we need 45–60 days to complete internal approvals). If we can get the 60-day extension and credits we will prioritize the reserved-seat purchase and expect to convert before Sep 20th.

We appreciate the conditional approach. Can you share the proposed addendum text and cost-equivalency for the token credit today? Our legal (Priyanka) is on copy and can review a short form addendum.

Best,
Elena
VP Product, NovumAI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: NovumAI ask — extra sandbox time + credits (needs exec signoff)

Hiro / Aditya —

Draft proposal for executive approval and the addendum language (short summary):

Offer A (conditional prefered):
- 60-day sandbox extension from 2026-08-27
- One-time credit: 150,000 generate tokens (internal list value $9,000)
- Condition: NovumAI signs the attached one-page addendum committing to a target purchase order by 2026-09-20 OR a minimum committed spend of $15k within 90 days after the extension.

Offer B (conservative fallback):
- 30-day extension + 75,000 tokens if procurement cannot commit to the addendum timeline.

Addendum key points (for legal):
- Extension date window and start date
- Credit usage limited to inference endpoints; no training/fine-tune usage
- Credit expires at end of extension window (no rollover)
- Conversion clause: if a signed PO is received by 2026-09-20, credits are applied toward the PO and any remaining balance invoiced/credited per normal terms

Finance/Impact: I'm estimating a write-off exposure up to $9k in list value under Offer A. If approved, I'll coordinate with finance to record as contra-revenue and track conversion triggers.

Please advise — if approved, I will: (1) send the addendum to Elena/Priyanka, (2) create the DocuSign envelope, (3) notify billing to set token caps.

— Marissa
From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ramos <elena@novumai.com>, Priyanka Singh <psingh@novumai.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 09:00:00 +0000
Subject: Re: NovumAI ask — extra sandbox time + credits (needs exec signoff)

Appreciate the clear framing. I authorize Offer A as a one-time, non-precedent exception for NovumAI given the strategic fit and conversion likelihood. Conditions to include explicitly in the addendum:

1) Addendum signed by both parties by 2026-08-30 and DocuSign envelope created today.
2) Credits (150k tokens) applied only to inference endpoints on the sandbox project ID supplied by NovumAI; billing team to set guardrails to prevent misuse.
3) If NovumAI does not issue a PO or commit to minimum spend by 2026-09-20, the remaining unused credit will be forfeited and we revert to standard PLG limits (no further extensions).

Marissa — proceed to send the addendum to Elena/Priyanka and create the DocuSign envelope. Ben — keep me posted if procurement pushes the PO beyond the agreed date; we may need to re-evaluate.

I'll mark this as approved and notify finance to record the potential credit exposure.

— Hiro
